environment.description: Go Gin webhook service deployed on EC2 instance (i-0a3f7c9e2b) in us-east-1, running behind an ALB with standard HTTP listener. Instance has IAM role 'webhook-svc-role' with S3 and DynamoDB access. IMDSv1 enabled (HttpTokens: optional). Security group sg-0f4a8b2c allows all outbound traffic. Service listens on port 8080, ALB forwards port 443 -> 8080. No egress filtering or DNS pinning configured.
